description: A polyphonic wavetable oscillator. The table is navigated in two directions, by bank and by wave within the bank, and a swarm of detuned voices can be spread over both

notes: a base table of 64 banks of 64 waves of 256 points is loaded when the module is created, so it sounds before anything is imported
menu: MULTITHREADED — runs the oscillator on an extra thread; on macOS it starts switched off
LOAD BANK — reads a wav file into one bank slot; the slots are reached in groups of sixteen, under BANKS 0 --> 15, BANKS 16 --> 31, BANKS 32 --> 47 and BANKS 48 --> 63
LOAD GLOBAL BANK — reads in a whole set of banks saved as one file
SAVE ALL BANKS — writes every loaded bank out as one file, which is what a new module then starts from
REMOVE ALL BANKS — empties every bank
SWARMING VCOs COUNT — sets how many oscillators a swarm runs: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20 or 24 swarmers
PROCESSING BLOCK SIZES — sets the block the oscillator computes in, from 16 samples up to 2048 samples
POWER MODE — sets how hard the oscillator works: LOW POWER, MEDIUM POWER or HCF MODE
STOP GRAPHIC ANIMATIONS — switches the moving displays off
